name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 62 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2025-12-29, at wavelengths from 0.82 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
